name: zellner-theme
description: Port of the classic Zellner Vim color scheme to VS Code and other editors/tools
author: Yue Yu

scripts.package: pnpm --filter vscode-theme-zellner run package && pnpm --filter vscode-theme-zellner-extended run package
scripts.publish:vsce: pnpm --filter vscode-theme-zellner run publish:vsce && pnpm --filter vscode-theme-zellner-extended run publish:vsce
scripts.publish:ovsx: pnpm --filter vscode-theme-zellner run publish:ovsx && pnpm --filter vscode-theme-zellner-extended run publish:ovsx
scripts.publish:all: pnpm run publish:vsce && pnpm run publish:ovsx
